text:
elaine: Quick PSA  someone dumped a full jar of used coffee grounds in the sink drain basket and the kitchen smells like espresso backwash :coffee: 

jo: oh no, that was me this morning  thought it was the compost bin, my bad. I can clean it out now.

ben: thanks jo. note: the kombucha in the fridge on the middle shelf (no name) is getting fizzy-rage-level. If it's yours, rescue it before it becomes kinetic.

harry: not mine. I did bring the stash of single-serve oat creamers last week though. Happy to restock if we're low.

kitchen-bot: maintenance reminder: fridge defrost scheduled in 3 days. Please clear any personal containers from top shelf by 10:00am Friday. See https://redwood.internal/ops/fridge for details.

olivia: can we get a small sign for "Shared items: label with name & date"? People leave science experiments in there.

facilities: we can print laminated 4x6 signs. I have a blank batch at my desk. Want us to pin them to the fridge?

elaine: yes please pin. Also vote: permanent communal compost bin vs "take-your-grounds-home" policy? react with :deciduous_tree: for communal, :house: for home.

jo: :deciduous_tree: communal and I'll be more careful about where I dump stuff.

ben: :house: I take my grounds home usually but okay with communal if it's a sealed container.

harry: :deciduous_tree: as long as we have a lid and empty it weekly.

olivia: facilities, could you add a small pedal bin with liner to the corner? that would help.

facilities: yes we can. I'll order a 5L pedal bin and a stack of liners. Pls allow 5 business days.

elaine: also tiny FYI: there's a mysterious half-sandwich in the microwave labelled "maybe eat?" Anyone claim?

jo: not mine. I'm wary.

ben: I'll brave it for science. report back in 5.

ben: verdict: smells like turkey  I rejected it. cleaned the plate and tossed the rest in compost.

kitchen-bot: inventory update: single-serve oat creamer - 2 left, espresso beans - full bag, ground coffee - low. Update here: https://redwood.internal/kitchen-inventory

elaine: action items: facilities orders pedal bin + signs; jo will mop the sink area today; ben restocked paper towels; olivia will pin signs when delivered. Thanks all, crisis mostly averted :sweat_smile:
